name: 파일
description: 프로젝트의 파일 트리와 즐겨찾기를 사이드바에 보여 준다. 카드 표면은 없다.

status.name: files.tree
status.description: The project folder, the last failure to list it or null, and the visible rows of the file tree in order: each entry's path relative to the folder, name, whether it is a directory, its depth, and whether it is expanded. The rows are listed again when the files sidecar reports a change in the project folder or an expanded directory.

status.name: files.bookmarks
status.description: The bookmarked paths of the project, relative to its folder, in the order they were added.

status.name: files.git
status.description: The git status of the project folder from the files sidecar: each path relative to the folder with added, deleted, modified, renamed, or untracked; empty when the folder is not in a git repository. It is read again after every listing.

status.name: files.selection
status.description: The path of the selected file or folder of the project's file trees, relative to the project folder, or null. Every mounted tree shows this selection.

commands.name: files.refresh
commands.description: Lists the project folder and every expanded directory again.

commands.name: files.tree.toggle
commands.description: Expands a listed directory of the file tree, or folds it with its expanded subdirectories.

commands.name: files.bookmarks.add
commands.description: Adds a path relative to the project folder to the bookmarks unless it is already there.

commands.name: files.select
commands.description: Selects a path of the file tree, or clears the selection with null.
